messages:
toni: Quick post-GA planning sync. We're getting three recurring asks: unpredictable tail latency on multi-turn chats, streaming sessions cutting off around token ~1100, and a handful of customers asking for clearer onboarding rate-limit language. Need to pick a pragmatic scope for the next 2-week iteration: do we push bugs-first (latency + streaming) or take a split approach so small UX wins land quickly?

ajay: From infra data, p99 latency jumps coincide with cache eviction bursts when long sessions accumulate KV growth. A low-risk mitigation is prefix cache pinning for hot prefixes which is ~2 dev-days + 1 canary. That should drop tail substantially.

lucy: UX: onboarding copy is tiny but high-impact for churn. I can land a copy + tooltip change in 1 dev-day; suggests we ship that as a hotpatch during the iteration. Also prototyped wording: "We limit streaming sessions to X tokens to protect latency; upgrade options explained".

ben: QA: streaming cutoff repro is flaky but reproducible with model variant `chat-xl-v2` + long context. I'll add two tests: `stream_resumption_after_socket_drop` and `stream_length_boundary` and run them against canary. We'll need to quarantine flaky ones until fix lands.

toni: Proposal: Sprint plan = Week1: P0 prefix-cache pinning hotfix canary at 8% (ajay + eng-runtime) + hotpatch onboarding copy (lucy). Week2: P1 streaming continuity (ben + eng-runtime) with model routing to safer variant for long sessions. Keep other polish in backlog.

ajay: Sounds good. I'll open tickets and a canary deploy: INF-2305 (prefix cache pinning) https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-2305. Branch `hotfix/inf-2305-cache-pin`. Canary target: 2026-04-02T16:00Z at 8%.

lucy: I'll send the copy PR and small CSS tweak: PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/334. If safe, we can push to prod before canary so customers see improved copy while runtime fix rolls.

ben: QA note: will run the two new tests on canary traffic. Add trace tag `prefix_cache_eviction` so we can filter. If p99 delta > 12% we plan rollback.

toni: Communication plan: draft a brief customer note after canary completes with results + expected timeline for streaming fix. If canary looks good, promote and schedule an infra patch for Dedicated pools.

ajay: Also adding a temporary routing rule: long sessions on `chat-xl-v2` go to `chat-l-compat` during canary to reduce user impact. Documenting in INF-2305.

lucy: I'll add screenshots to the release note for the onboarding copy change.

toni: OK locking scope. Deliverables: INF-2305 (P0 cache pinning), INF-2306 (P1 streaming continuity), INF-2307 (onboard copy hotpatch). Next sync Fri 9:30am to review canary metrics. Thanks everyone :raised_hands:
